notices.asked: Everyone will be asked for their cookie choice again.

errors.language: Choose one of the languages offered.
errors.id: That is not a valid record.
errors.permission: Choose a permission for this audience.
errors.daysOrPermanent: Enter the number of days, or tick permanent.

general.heading: General
general.subtitle: The site's name, default language, profile posts, the forum statistics panel and the accounts it links to.
general.linksDescription: The site's own accounts elsewhere, shown in the footer.
general.analyticsDescription: A visitor analytics tag added to every public page. The staff panel never carries it.

home.heading: What's new
home.subtitle: Which tab What's new (the feed page) opens on for visitors who have not picked their own. The first rule a visitor meets decides; the fallback is for everyone else. Members can still pick their own tab in their preferences, and every tab is one click away.
home.positionHelp: Rules are tried from the lowest position. Equal positions keep the order shown.
home.excludedHelp: Threads in the forums you tick (and the forums under them) are never listed in the feed of What's new, for anyone, even when a filter names the forum. The forums themselves stay open everywhere else. A member can also hide forums from their own feed.
home.fallbackHelp: Following needs an account, so a rule that guests can meet cannot open on it, and neither can the fallback.

members.heading: New members
members.subtitle: Who may register and what the sign-up asks, how long a member counts as new and what is held back from them.
members.registrationNote: Who may create an account, what the sign-up form asks and how a new account is let in.

welcome.heading: Welcome message
welcome.note: A private message from the site to each new member, sent once when the account becomes a confirmed member: after its email is confirmed and, if sign-ups wait for approval, after staff approve it. People who already have an account are not sent one.
welcome.enabledSwitch: Send a welcome message to new members
welcome.senderHelp: The member the message comes from. Leave it empty to use the first administrator. The sender's conversation limits do not apply and the sender is not alerted.
welcome.subjectHelp: Use '{'name'}' for the new member's username. Leave the subject and the message empty to use the site's own text, in the language the member signed up in.
welcome.bodyHelp: BB code is allowed. Use '{'name'}' for the new member's username.

antispam.heading: Anti-spam
antispam.subtitle: How fast a member may write, who may post links or go live without review, what a signature may hold, and the Cloudflare Turnstile check on the guest forms. Daily limits, the restriction that shows outside pictures and media as links (a group given Never on it is exempt), and the bypasses for the flood interval, the word filter and the spam check are permissions: set them on the permissions screen.
antispam.signaturesNote: Checked when a member saves a signature and measured on what it shows, so different BB code that draws the same thing counts the same. For the counts and the text size, 0 and -1 both mean no limit; to forbid links or pictures, leave them out of the allowed formatting. Quotes, tables, code blocks, spoilers, media and more than one paragraph are never allowed. Signatures already saved are not checked again until their owner saves them.
antispam.loginWarning: Careful: if the secret is wrong, nobody can sign in, you included. Tick this only after registration works with the same keys.
antispam.turnstileNote: Visitors without an account solve a check before the forms below are sent; signed-in members never see it. The backend verifies every answer with Cloudflare and fails closed: if Cloudflare cannot be reached the guarded forms are refused until it can, so nobody can register, sign in or ask for an email in the meantime. A wrong secret makes Cloudflare refuse every answer, which blocks every guarded form, so sign-in is not guarded by default: tick it only once registration works. Create a widget in the Cloudflare dashboard and paste its keys here. It is listed in the cookie policy as strictly necessary for security.

cookies.heading: Cookies and privacy
cookies.subtitle: Who the cookie banner is shown to, how the statistics are counted, and when everyone is asked again. The words of the cookie policy page are a page you write under Pages, with the address cookies.
cookies.versionHelp: Visitors and members answer the banner for one version of the policy. Raise it when what the site stores in the browser, or why, changes: every saved choice, in the browser and on member accounts, then stops counting and the banner asks again. It cannot be lowered or typed in.
cookies.askAgainWarning: Every visitor and member will be asked for their cookie choice again, and nothing optional loads for them until they answer.

warnings.heading: Warnings
warnings.subtitle: The warning types moderators pick, and the actions applied automatically when a member's warning points reach a threshold.

uploads.heading: Uploads
uploads.subtitle: How big an upload may be, which file types each purpose takes and the storage each group gets.
uploads.typesDescription: One content type per line, such as image/png. Catalog and site pictures always take JPEG, PNG and WebP.
uploads.groupsDescription: How much a member of the group may keep uploaded, in bytes. Leave a field empty for unlimited; 0 allows no storage. The save sends every group's value, so the groups you leave alone keep theirs.

seo.heading: Search engines
seo.subtitle: How pages are titled in search results and how search engines are told about changes.

levels.heading: Levels
levels.subtitle: The level curve, the limits of profile text and the weights of the member of the month.
levels.standingNote: The winners of past months follow these rules: when you change a weight, the staff switch, the listed members or the rule below, every past month is decided again in the background, newest first, and a member who loses a month loses it without being told.
levels.noPreview: The site gives no table of levels to read, so no preview is shown here.

navigation.heading: Public navigation
navigation.subtitle: The links of the header, the bottom bar on a phone, the account menu and the footer. Built-in entries can be renamed, reordered and switched off; entries you add can also be deleted.

siteDescription.label: Site description
siteDescription.help: One or two sentences about the site. Shown to search engines and in the footer; leave empty to show neither.

defaultLanguage.label: Default language
defaultLanguage.help: Language for guests and members who have not chosen one.

profilePostsEnabled.label: Profile posts
profilePostsEnabled.help: Off: nobody can create profile posts or comments.

newMemberDays.label: New-member period
newMemberDays.help: How long after joining a member counts as new for the mention limit below.

firstPostsToModerate.label: First posts held for review
firstPostsToModerate.help: How many of a new member's first posts wait for a moderator. 0 holds none.

moderateLinksFromNewMembers.label: Links from new members
moderateLinksFromNewMembers.help: On: posts by new members that contain links wait for a moderator.
moderateLinksFromNewMembers.switch: Hold posts with links from new members

approveSignups.label: Approve new accounts
approveSignups.help: Turning this off lets new accounts in at once. The accounts already waiting stay in the queue, and staff can still decide them.
approveSignups.switch: New accounts wait for staff approval

floodSeconds.label: Flood interval
floodSeconds.help: Seconds a member must wait between two posts. Threads, replies, wall posts, wall comments and direct messages share one clock. 0 turns it off. Groups with the flood bypass permission are exempt.

newMemberMentionLimit.label: Mentions per item
newMemberMentionLimit.help: Mentions allowed per post or message for members younger than the new-member period. The general mention limit applies as well.

cookieBannerOutsideEu.label: Cookie banner outside Europe
cookieBannerOutsideEu.help: On (the default): everyone is asked. Off: only visitors in the EU, the EEA, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, and visitors whose country is not known, are asked. Guests elsewhere who have never answered the banner are treated as having accepted every category until they choose in the cookie settings, so the statistics, referrals and embeds work for them without a banner. Members, and anyone who answered before (under any policy version), are always asked. The country is read only from the location a trusted proxy reports (see the deployment guide); without one every visitor is asked.
cookieBannerOutsideEu.switch: Show the banner to visitors outside Europe

matomoCookieless.label: Matomo without cookies
matomoCookieless.help: Runs the Matomo tag in its cookieless mode and loads it without asking for consent; the banner then has no statistics choice and the cookie policy page says so. It applies only when the analytics provider in General is Matomo. Whether consent is needed for cookieless statistics varies by country: check the rules that apply to you.
matomoCookieless.switch: Matomo runs without cookies and without consent

maxUploadBytes.label: Largest file
maxUploadBytes.help: The biggest single file an upload may carry.

threadTitleTemplate.label: Thread page title
threadTitleTemplate.help: Title of a thread page. Use '{'title'}' for the thread's title and '{'site'}' for the site name.

nodeTitleTemplate.label: Forum page title
nodeTitleTemplate.help: Title of a forum or category page. Use '{'title'}' for its name and '{'site'}' for the site name.

profileTitleTemplate.label: Profile page title
profileTitleTemplate.help: Title of a member's profile. Use '{'username'}' for the member's name and '{'site'}' for the site name.

indexNowKey.label: IndexNow key
indexNowKey.help: The key search engines check to accept change notices from this site. Leave empty to send none.

levelStep.label: Level step
levelStep.help: Levels come from the XP of the awards a member holds. Each level costs this much more XP than the one before: level n starts at step × n × (n − 1) / 2.

levelTitles.label: Level titles
levelTitles.help: The title of a level is the entry with the highest level not above it. Clear both fields of a row to remove it; the empty rows at the end add titles.

signatureMaxLength.label: Signature length
signatureMaxLength.help: Longest signature a member may have.

signatureMaxLinks.label: Signature links
signatureMaxLinks.help: Most links in a signature, whatever they point to. 0 or -1: no limit. Needs links among the allowed formatting.

signatureMaxImages.label: Signature pictures
signatureMaxImages.help: Most pictures in a signature. 0 or -1: no limit. Needs pictures among the allowed formatting.

signatureMaxSmilies.label: Signature smilies
signatureMaxSmilies.help: Most emoji in a signature. Every pictograph counts on its own, also inside a joined sequence (a family is three), and a flag or a keycap counts once. The forum has no text smilies, so :) is plain text. 0 or -1: no limit.

signatureMaxTextSize.label: Signature text size
signatureMaxTextSize.help: The largest size a signature may use, from 1 to 7 as in [SIZE=n]. A heading counts as 8 minus its level: a level 1 heading is size 7. 0 or -1: no limit.

signatureFormats.label: Allowed formatting
signatureFormats.help: The kinds of formatting a signature may use. One that is not ticked is refused when the signature is saved, never stripped silently.

turnstileEnabled.label: Turnstile
turnstileEnabled.help: Needs a site key and a secret. It cannot be turned on without them, and neither can be removed while it is on.
turnstileEnabled.switch: Check visitors on the forms below

turnstileSiteKey.label: Site key
turnstileSiteKey.help: The public key of the widget. It is sent to every visitor's browser.

turnstileSecret.label: Secret key
turnstileSecret.help: Kept on the server and never shown again. Type a new one to replace it; leave this empty to keep the stored one.

turnstileForms.label: Guarded forms
turnstileForms.help: Only forms for visitors without an account. Password change, replying and every other form need a signed-in member, who is never asked. A signed-in member asking for their own confirmation email is not asked either.

customTitleMaxLength.label: Custom title length
customTitleMaxLength.help: Longest custom title a member may have.

standingPostPoints.label: Points per post
standingPostPoints.help: Member of the month: points = posts × this + reactions received ÷ reactions per point + referrals × points per referral.

standingReactionsPerPoint.label: Reactions per point
standingReactionsPerPoint.help: How many reactions received make one point.

standingReferralPoints.label: Points per referral
standingReferralPoints.help: Points for each member a member brought in.

standingExcludeStaff.label: Exclude staff
standingExcludeStaff.help: Members who hold moderation or administration permissions are left out of the standings and cannot win the month.
standingExcludeStaff.switch: Leave staff out of the member of the month

standingExcludedUserIds.label: Excluded members
standingExcludedUserIds.help: Usernames, one per line or separated by commas. These members are left out of the standings and cannot win the month. Past winners are decided again when this list changes.

discord.label: Discord
discord.help: An http(s) address. Leave empty to leave it out.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.help: An http(s) address. Leave empty to leave it out.

x.label: X
x.help: An http(s) address. Leave empty to leave it out.

provider.label: Provider
provider.help: None adds nothing. Fill in only the fields of the provider you choose.

url.label: Matomo address
url.help: The https address of your Matomo installation, for example https://stats.example.com/.

siteId.label: Matomo site id
siteId.help: The number Matomo gives this site.

measurementId.label: Google measurement id
measurementId.help: Starts with G-, for example G-ABC123XYZ.

registrationOpen.label: Registration
registrationOpen.help: Turning this off stops visitors from creating accounts: the sign-up page says it is closed and the backend refuses every attempt. Existing accounts are not affected.

minimumAge.label: Minimum age
minimumAge.help: The youngest age that may register, counted in whole years by the UTC calendar day. Above 0 the sign-up form asks for a date of birth and refuses a visitor who is younger. 0 asks for no age.

registrationFields.label: Required profile fields
registrationFields.help: The sign-up form asks for the ticked profile fields and refuses a visitor who leaves one empty. The date of birth is asked whenever there is a minimum age.

requireEmailConfirmation.label: Email confirmation
requireEmailConfirmation.help: On: a new account is Unconfirmed until its owner follows the link in the email. Off: new accounts are members at once, no link is sent and the welcome email goes out at sign-up instead. It only matters on a site that sends email (it does nothing without a mail driver); accounts already unconfirmed stay so.
requireEmailConfirmation.switch: New accounts must confirm their email address

add.title: Title
add.targetHelp: A path of this site such as /forums, or an http(s) address. Pick a built-in route from the list or type your own. Leave empty for a heading.
add.parentHelp: A top-level entry of the same place, or none for a top-level entry.
add.orderHelp: Entries show from the lowest number up.
add.iconHelp: Drawn next to the title. The bottom bar on a phone always draws it above the title.
add.permissionHelp: Used only with the audience holders of a permission.

row.heading: Heading
row.noChildren: No enabled entries under this heading.
row.deleteWarning: Deletes {title} and every entry under it. This cannot be undone.
row.empty: There is no navigation entry yet.

new.heading: New entry
new.subtitle: A link to a page of the site or to another site, or a heading that only groups links.

edit.heading: Edit entry
edit.subtitle: Rename the entry, change who sees it or switch it off. Its place, target and parent stay as they are.

sort.heading: Sort entries
sort.subtitle: Move entries up or down inside their place, or under their heading, and save each list.
sort.none: No place or heading holds two or more entries to put in order.

identity.heading: Site identity
identity.subtitle: The pictures that make the site recognisable: its logo, its browser icon and the backdrop behind its pages.
identity.formDescription: A picture is uploaded as soon as you choose it and takes effect when you save. Only the pictures you change are saved.

errors.file: That is not a valid uploaded file.

logoFileId.label: Logo
logoFileId.help: Shown in the header of every page, in place of the drawn mark. Without one, the site name is shown with the drawn mark.

iconFileId.label: Icon
iconFileId.help: The small picture on the browser tab and in bookmarks. A square PNG works best.

backdropFileId.label: Page backdrop
backdropFileId.help: Drawn across the top of every page, fading out downwards. Without one, the drawn pattern is shown.

warningTypes.heading: Warning types
warningTypes.description: What a moderator picks when warning a member. A type sets the points, the expiry and a reason to start from.
warningTypes.none: There are no warning types. Moderators give custom warnings.
warningTypes.expiresAfter: Expires after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
warningTypes.deleteWarning: Warnings already given under this type stay as they are, as custom warnings.

form.descriptionNew: Named in both languages; members read the one they use.
form.pointsHelp: The points a warning of this type carries.
form.expiryDaysHelp: Leave empty for warnings that never expire.
form.defaultReasonHelp: Used when the moderator gives no reason of their own.
form.lockedHelp: Moderators cannot change the points or the expiry of this type.

warningActions.heading: Automatic actions
warningActions.description: Applied once when a member's active warning points reach the threshold, and again only after the points have fallen below it and reached it anew. Changes count from the next warning. A group added for a limited time is taken back when the points fall below the threshold or the time ends. Bans and restrictions end on their own date and are never lifted early; permanent group memberships stay.
warningActions.forDays: for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
warningActions.deleteWarning: Group memberships it added for a limited time end now. Bans, restrictions and permanent memberships stay.

form.descriptionNew: A member who holds the permission that exempts them from automatic actions is skipped, and the last administrator cannot be banned. An action that adds a group needs the permission to manage members and your own password.
form.thresholdHelp: The action applies when a member's unexpired points reach this number.
form.kindHelp: The group or the restriction below is used only when the action asks for it.
form.daysHelp: How long the ban, membership or restriction lasts. Or tick permanent.
form.groupHelp: A group ranked below yours that does not administer permissions.
form.groupTyped: Type the number of the group; you may not list the groups.
form.restrictionHelp: Used when the action is a restriction.
form.passwordHelp: Needed to add, change or delete an action that adds a group; leave it empty for the others.
